collision_probability.encounter_plane_definition: e_v = normalized relative velocity; e_1 is the normalized TCA miss vector projected perpendicular to e_v (or a deterministic least-aligned Cartesian axis at zero miss); e_2 = cross(e_v, e_1); project the common-frame relative position covariance onto [e_1, e_2].
assumptions: TCA relative-position uncertainty is represented by a bivariate Gaussian.
Relative motion is locally linear over the encounter interval.
Relative position covariance is treated as constant over the encounter interval.
No covariance-independence assumption was authorized; cross-object correlation remains unknown.
warnings: Applicability assumptions are not independently verified by TLE-only propagation.
This is a research implementation and is not NASA operational conjunction software.

automatic_research_pc_assessment.method_name: ORION ESA population-prior Foster 2D research estimate
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_method: ESA Kelvins component-wise population covariance prior; diagonal local RTN assigned at TCA and rotated to TEME; configured age, orbit-band, eccentricity and BSTAR scale factors.
automatic_research_pc_assessment.hbr_method: ESA target/chaser span population prior by ORION object class; assumed span diameter converted to a per-object radius and combined; not an authenticated object dimension.

provenance.log_domain_fallback: same Foster circular Gaussian integral, used only when probability-domain Foster quadrature fails

automatic_research_pc_assessment.ranking_basis: LOW under orion-geometry-review-v1; geometry-only queue rank, separate from Pc
automatic_research_pc_assessment.sensitivity_reason: Range is the min/max of coupled ESA p10, p50 and p90 prior scenarios; it is not a statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
ESA Kelvins CDM-derived population p10/p50/p90 component sigmas are used as per-object priors; they are not live-object measurements.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 joint scenarios vary all component sigmas and span together; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.

ai_risk_assessment.explanation: Normalized geometry/speed queue index: proximity 0.122 (miss 21.9462 km / 25 km screen), relative-speed component 0.965 (reference 15 km/s); deterministic fallback, not Pc or trained ESA prediction.
ai_risk_assessment.ranking_explanation: Final priority combines 50% deterministic AI queue index, 30% normalized geometry, and 20% relative Pc percentile only in a multi-event result where every event has the same Pc provenance (a within-screening-set percentile from the labeled ESA-prior research Pc); otherwise AI and geometry weights are renormalized and Pc rankings remain separate. An ESA-prior Pc retains its unvalidated research-prior status and is not treated as operationally calibrated.
